steps.player: Well met, fellow adventurer.

steps.npc: Adventurer? I am no mere Adventurer, I am Andros Mai, brother of the Holy Order of Saradomin. You would do well to greet me with respect.

steps.player: Andros Mai? Sorry, but I can't say I've heard of you I'm afraid.

steps.npc: I wouldn't have expected someone of your... stature to know of me.
Tell me, what do you know of the vile Vet'ion?

steps.player: Nothing, but I have a feeling you're about to fill me in.

steps.text: With at least one Vet'ion kill:

steps.player: We've crossed swords in the past, I can't say I'm too keen to do it again though.

steps.npc: You challenged him and came out unscathed? Impossible.

steps.player: I'm stronger than I look.
But why do you ask? What do you want with Vet'ion?

steps.npc: Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak. It is the will of my order and my duty as a follower of the true god Saradomin to end his tyranny.
After many years in my order's libraries, I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.
His very existence is an insult to my lord Saradomin and I will not suffer it to exist any longer.

steps.player: Then why are you waiting here? Seems to me that you don't want to face Vet'ion.

steps.npc: I have no fear of Vet'ion!
I am merely meditating and preparing for the battle. I need to focus my mind before going out to find his resting place.

steps.player: It's okay, sometimes I pretend to be busy when there's something I don't want to do, too.

steps.npc: This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.

options.condition: If the player has Viggora's chainmace or the Claws of Callisto:

steps.text: With only Viggora's chainmace in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the chainmace to Andros Mai.

steps.npc: By Saradomin! That's a Zamorakian made chainmace you have there!

steps.player: And? Do you know anything about it?

steps.npc: I know melee weapons in general. Well enough to know most of them can be upgraded.
Perhaps with something sharp to give it more impact as it swings around.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.

steps.text: With only the Claws of Callisto in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the claws to Andros Mai.

steps.npc: They look like powerful claws. You could probably attach them to a weapon to make the weapon stronger.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the chainmace to Andros Mai.

steps.npc: By Saradomin! That's a Zamorakian made chainmace you have there!

steps.player: And? Do you know anything about it?

steps.npc: I know melee weapons in general. Well enough to know most of them can be upgraded.
Perhaps with something sharp to give it more impact as it swings around.

steps.player: Perhaps I could use this?

steps.text: You show the Claws of Callisto to Andros Mai.

steps.npc: Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.

steps.player: Could you combine them?

steps.npc: While I could, I'd really not like to.

steps.player: Surely you could consider it... For the right price?

steps.npc: Money has been tight lately...
And my supplies are running low...
Fine. But I want 500,000 coins for that. No less.

steps.prompt: Pay 500,000 coins to combine the claws and chainmace?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have the money for that.

steps.npc: Feel free to come back when you do.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:
Andros Mai combines the items and gives you the Ursine chainmace (u).

steps.npc: There we go! All done.

steps.player: No thanks.

using-items-on-him-fangs-of-venenatis.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-fangs-of-venenatis.text: You show the fangs to Andros Mai.

using-items-on-him-fangs-of-venenatis.npc: No. I'm afraid not. They just look like fangs.

using-items-on-him-fangs-of-venenatis.player: Fangs indeed. Rather useless it seems.

using-items-on-him-fangs-of-venenatis.npc: Perhaps not. I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.text: You show the skull to Andros Mai.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: That's him! The vile Vet'Ion. I should like to smash this skull!

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: Wait! It seems to still contain some magic. Surely we can use it?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: The only thing his skull would be useful for is Zamorakian heresy. I won't stand for it!

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: Is there really nothing you can do to help me with this?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: Do you see Phabelle over there? Despite her questionable morals, she's my friend.
She's good with magic and may know how to take advantage of the powers in that skull.

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.text: You show the weapon piece to Andros Mai.

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.player: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.npc: Downstairs you can find Madam Sikaro. Though she's on the wrong path, perhaps she could assist you.
